name: Mehdi Mohebbi
interests: Wearable sensing and human activity recognition

education.degree: M.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence and Soft Computing)
education.thesis: Document-Level Offline Handwritten Text Recognition using Deep Learning Approaches

bullets: Designing compact handwritten text recognition models for English and Persian using JEPA-style latent prediction.
Working with wearable and smartphone motion-sensor (IMU) data for human activity recognition and neurological disorder diagnosis.

Built the 1st-place SHL Challenge entries for smartphone-sensor locomotion recognition: in 2025, an ensemble of pre-trained time-series foundation models and biosignal models trained from scratch; in 2026, early and late fusion of frozen time-series foundation models.
Research on Graphical Finite Population Sampling (GFS); co-developed an open-source Python package that implements and extends it (github.com/mehdimhb/graphical-sampling).
Introduced Intelligent n-Means Spatial Sampling, a GFS-based method for designing well-spread samples that give more precise estimates in spatial populations.
Proposed a new index for measuring the spatial spread of samples.
Developing deep learning models to learn and optimize the space of sampling designs for given populations.
Natural Language Processing (Spring 2026), Dr. Bagher BabaAli.
Principles of Theory of Computation (Spring 2023), Dr. Arash Ahadi.
Foundations of Numerical Analysis (Fall 2023), Dr. Jamshid Saeidian.
Designed and conducted a market research study for Divar with Dr. Bardia Panahbehagh, including the sampling plan and survey methodology for collecting representative market data.
